one_line: An elite Satavahana queen–donor from the Deccan, embodying matronymic lineage and public religious patronage in the 1st–3rd century CE.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s to early 30s, medium height, graceful but sturdy build suggesting a life of comfort with disciplined poise.
appearance.face: Soft oval face with warm medium-brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, full lips, slightly arched brows and large anime-style dark brown eyes; a calm, composed default expression with a hint of quiet authority.
appearance.hair: Long black hair oiled and drawn back into a high rounded bun at the back of the head, wrapped with a narrow gold band; a central hair parting dusted with a thin red sindoor line and a small round red bindi on the forehead.
appearance.costume: A region-accurate early Deccan noblewoman’s outfit: an unstitched sari-like drape of fine cotton in deep turmeric yellow with a broad maroon border and thin indigo stripe, wrapped securely around the waist, falling in pleats to the ankles and brought over the left shoulder as an upper-body veil, worn over a short-sleeved maroon cotton blouse that fully covers the torso; a simple indigo cotton under-skirt adds volume; jewellery includes a pair of medium-sized gold hoop earrings, a single gold nose-ring in the left nostril, two layered gold bead necklaces (one short collar length, one reaching mid-chest), three slim gold bangles on each wrist, and a narrow gold girdle belt at the waist, plus plain leather sandals.
appearance.signature: A smooth stone cave-donation tablet held in her left hand, rectangular and slate-grey, with shallow incised lines suggesting Prakrit Brahmi inscription, while her right hand lightly rests on a small palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with a cotton cord at her waist.

ref_desc: Satavahana Royal Patroness with an oval medium-brown face, large dark eyes, black hair in a high bun with gold band, turmeric yellow sari with maroon border over maroon blouse, gold jewellery, and a grey inscribed stone donation tablet, accented with indigo details.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a Satavahana Royal Patroness from 1st–3rd century CE Deccan: an elite woman in her late 20s with an oval medium-brown face, large dark brown eyes, calm authoritative expression, and long black hair oiled into a high rounded bun at the back of her head, wrapped by a narrow gold band, with a central part line touched with red sindoor and a small round red bindi; she wears a historically accurate early Deccan noblewoman’s dress, a fine cotton sari-like drape in deep turmeric yellow with a broad maroon border and a thin indigo stripe, wrapped securely around her waist, pleated to the ankles and brought over her left shoulder as a modest upper-body veil, over a short-sleeved maroon cotton blouse that fully covers her torso and an indigo cotton under-skirt for volume; her jewellery is modest but regal: medium gold hoop earrings, a single small gold nose-ring in the left nostril, two layered gold bead necklaces (one at the collar and one mid-chest), three slim gold bangles on each wrist, and a narrow gold girdle at her waist, and she wears plain leather sandals; her signature props are a smooth rectangular grey stone donation tablet with faint incised inscription lines cradled in her left hand and a small palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with cotton hanging at her waist, and the dominant colours are turmeric yellow, maroon, indigo, warm brown skin tone, and gold, shown from multiple angles to emphasise consistent face, hair, clothing, jewellery, and tablet design.
